channel.title: Slow-Blues.com – Blues Blog
channel.description: In-depth articles about blues history, essential albums, Scandinavian blues, and the music's journey from the Mississippi Delta to the rest of the world. Written with passion by Kjell Mersland.

item.title: Weekly Blues Dispatch (Week 09): Blues Music Awards Nominees, BluesGig Launch & Duke Robillard's New Album!
item.dc:creator: Kjell Mersland
item.description: The Blues Foundation just dropped the 2026 Blues Music Awards nominees – and it's a stacked field. Plus: we introduce BluesGig, our new all-in-one tool for Nordic blues clubs, Duke Robillard drops 'Blast Off!', and Oz & The Wizards' release concert is just two weeks away!
item.sb:sources: The Blues Foundation, Stony Plain Records, Slow-Blues.com, Kristiansand Bluesklubb

item.title: Weekly Blues Dispatch: February Birthdays, Oz & The Wizards Release Concert & Your Help Wanted!
item.dc:creator: Kjell Mersland
item.description: This week we celebrate the blues legends born in February – from Lonnie Johnson to Knut Reiersrud – hype the upcoming Oz & The Wizards release concert in Kristiansand, spotlight Duke Robillard's brand-new album, and make a heartfelt plea for your help with artist photos and information. Plus: have you tried our Blues Quiz yet?
item.sb:sources: Slow-Blues.com Research, Kristiansand Bluesklubb, Stony Plain Records

item.title: Buddy Guy Just Won What Might Be His Last Grammy – And I Need a Minute
item.dc:creator: Kjell Mersland
item.description: The 2026 Grammys gave Buddy Guy Best Traditional Blues Album for 'Ain't Done With The Blues.' At 89, this might be the final chapter – and it hit me harder than I expected. Plus: Big Blues Bender drops a monster lineup, Billy Branch proves Chicago harp is still king, and a Florida festival just booked the perfect blues weekend.
item.sb:sources: Grammy Awards 2026 Official Results, Alligator Records, Blues Foundation

item.title: Blues in February 2026 – New Albums, Tours & Festival Announcements
item.dc:creator: Kjell Mersland
item.description: February 2026 is loaded with blues action: Joe Bonamassa drops a monumental B.B. King tribute, Lil' Ed & The Blues Imperials return with a Chicago slide masterpiece, Tinsley Ellis goes acoustic, and Kingfish launches his Hard Road Tour.
item.sb:sources: Alligator Records, J&R Adventures, Vintage Guitar Magazine, Notodden Blues Festival

item.title: The Women Who Shaped the Blues
item.dc:creator: Kjell Mersland
item.description: From Ma Rainey and Bessie Smith to Koko Taylor and modern trailblazers – the often-overlooked story of women who were foundational to the blues.
item.sb:sources: The Blues Foundation, Library of Congress, Angela Davis – 'Blues Legacies and Black Feminism'

item.title: Blues in Scandinavia – How the Delta Sound Traveled North
item.dc:creator: Kjell Mersland
item.description: The unlikely but passionate story of how Mississippi Delta blues took root in the cold Nordic countries and produced a vibrant blues scene.
item.sb:sources: Notodden Blues Festival Archives, Norwegian Blues Union, Helsinki Blues Festival

item.title: 10 Blues Albums You Must Hear Before You Die
item.dc:creator: Kjell Mersland
item.description: From Robert Johnson's haunting recordings to modern masterpieces – these are the essential blues albums that every music lover needs in their collection.
item.sb:sources: Chess Records, Stax Records, Robert Palmer – 'Deep Blues', Elijah Wald – 'Escaping the Delta'
